notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Welding Jar.
Cast Welding Jar from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Oak Guardian.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.
